description: Defines the HttpTransaction class and related interfaces for managing a single HTTP request/response transaction within the Chromium networking code. Includes method declarations for starting, restarting, reading, and managing connection states.

classes.name: HttpTransaction
classes.description: Represents a single HTTP transaction, providing methods to start, restart, read data, and manage connection states.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates the HTTP transaction by sending the request.

methods.name: RestartIgnoringLastError
methods.description: Restarts the transaction ignoring the last error, used for SSL errors and similar.

methods.name: RestartWithCertificate
methods.description: Restarts the transaction with a client certificate.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts the transaction with authentication credentials.

methods.name: IsReadyToRestartForAuth
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is ready to continue with authentication.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads response data into a buffer.

methods.name: StopCaching
methods.description: Stops further caching of the request.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: DoneReading
methods.description: Indicates that the entire response body has been read.

methods.name: GetResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns response information.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state.

methods.name: SetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Associates QUIC server info with the transaction.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Populates load timing information.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the remote endpoint of the connection.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: SetWebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper
methods.description: Sets helper for WebSocket handshake stream.

methods.name: SetBeforeNetworkStartCallback
methods.description: Sets callback before network start.

methods.name: SetConnectedCallback
methods.description: Sets callback upon connection.

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for request headers.

methods.name: SetEarlyResponseHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for early response headers.

methods.name: SetResponseHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for response headers.

methods.name: ResumeNetworkStart
methods.description: Resumes a deferred network start.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns connection attempt info.

methods.name: CloseConnectionOnDestruction
methods.description: Configures connection to close on destruction.
